cards.line: Abiathar, son of Ahimelech, was a high priest who served during the reigns of David and Solomon.

cards.line: Abner, the son of Ner, was King Saul's cousin and the commander of his army; he later supported Saul's son Ish-bosheth as king before defecting to David.

cards.line: Agabus, a prophet, foretold a famine and Paul's arrest in Jerusalem.

cards.name: Agag
cards.line: Agag, king of the Amalekites, was spared by Saul but killed by Samuel.

cards.name: Agrippa
cards.line: King Agrippa heard Paul's defense and found no grounds for his imprisonment.

cards.name: Ahab
cards.line: Ahab, son of Omri, reigned as king of Israel and did evil in the sight of the Lord.

cards.name: Amon
cards.line: Amon, the son of Manasseh, was the 15th king of Judah who reigned for two years before being assassinated by his servants.

cards.name: Andrew
cards.line: Andrew, the brother of Simon Peter, was one of the twelve apostles of Jesus Christ and played a significant role in the early church.

cards.name: Anna
cards.line: Anna, a prophetess and widow, witnessed the dedication of the infant Jesus in the temple and spoke about Him to all who were looking forward to the redemption of Jerusalem.

cards.name: Annas
cards.line: Annas, a high priest, played a significant role in the events surrounding Jesus' arrest, trial, and crucifixion, as well as in the early persecution of the apostles.

cards.name: Apollos
cards.line: Apollos, an eloquent and learned Jewish Christian from Alexandria, was an important figure in the early church who worked alongside Paul in spreading the gospel.

cards.name: Aquila
cards.line: Aquila, along with his wife Priscilla, was a Jewish Christian who worked as a tentmaker and played a significant role in the early church, partnering with Paul in his ministry.

cards.name: Archelaus
cards.line: Archelaus, son of Herod the Great, Ethnarch over Judea, causing Joseph to fear returning there with Mary and the child Jesus.

cards.name: Bar-jesus
cards.line: Bar-Jesus, also known as Elymas, was a Jewish sorcerer who tried to hinder Paul and Barnabas' ministry.

cards.name: Barabbas
cards.line: Barabbas, a notorious prisoner, was released by Pilate instead of Jesus at the crowd's demand.

cards.name: Barnabas
cards.line: Barnabas, also known as Joseph or Joses, was a Levite from Cyprus who played a significant role in the early church and accompanied Paul on missionary journeys.

cards.name: Bartholomew
cards.line: Bartholomew was one of the twelve apostles chosen by Jesus.

cards.name: Ben-hadad
cards.line: Ben-hadad I, king of Aram, made a treaty with Asa of Judah and attacked Israel during the reign of Baasha.

cards.name: Caiaphas
cards.line: Caiaphas, the high priest during Jesus' ministry, presided over Jesus' trial and played a key role in His crucifixion.

cards.name: Candace
cards.line: Candace, queen of the Ethiopians, is named in Acts 8:27 as the ruler whose treasurer Philip met and baptized on the road to Gaza.

cards.name: Colossians
cards.line: Letter of the New Testament, 4 chapters.

cards.name: Daniel
cards.line: Prophet book of the Old Testament, 12 chapters.

cards.name: David
cards.line: David, son of Jesse, was the anointed king of Israel, a man after God's own heart, and an ancestor of Jesus Christ.

cards.name: Deuteronomy
cards.line: Book of the Law of the Old Testament, 34 chapters.

cards.name: Ecclesiastes
cards.line: Poetry and wisdom book of the Old Testament, 12 chapters.

cards.name: Eleazar son of Aaron
cards.line: Eleazar was the son of Aaron and served as high priest after his father's death.

cards.name: Eli
cards.line: Eli was the high priest and judge of Israel who ministered at the tabernacle in Shiloh.

cards.name: Elijah
cards.line: Elijah was a prominent prophet in Israel during the reigns of Ahab and Ahaziah, known for his miracles and confrontations with the prophets of Baal.

cards.name: Epaphras
cards.line: Epaphras was a faithful minister of Christ and a fellow prisoner with Paul, who labored in prayer for the Colossians.

cards.name: Ephesians
cards.line: Letter of the New Testament, 6 chapters.

cards.name: Esther
cards.line: History book of the Old Testament, 10 chapters.

cards.name: Esther
cards.line: Esther, also known as Hadassah, was a Jewish queen of Persia who saved her people from genocide.

cards.name: Evil-merodach
cards.line: Evil-merodach was a king of Babylon who released Jehoiachin, the former king of Judah, from prison.

cards.name: Ezekiel
cards.line: Ezekiel was a prophet during the Babylonian exile who authored the Book of Ezekiel and served as a sign to the people of Israel.

cards.name: Ezra
cards.line: History book of the Old Testament, 10 chapters.

cards.name: Ezra
cards.line: Ezra was a priest and scribe who led a group of Jewish exiles back to Jerusalem and played a key role in the spiritual reformation of the people.

cards.name: Felix
cards.line: Felix was a Roman governor of Judea who heard the case against Paul and kept him in custody for two years.

cards.name: Festus
cards.line: Porcius Festus succeeded Felix as the Roman governor of Judea and heard Paul's case, ultimately sending him to Rome for trial.

cards.name: Galatians
cards.line: Letter of the New Testament, 6 chapters.

cards.name: Gallio
cards.line: Gallio, the Roman proconsul of Achaia, refused to judge Paul when the Jews brought charges against him in Corinth.

cards.name: Genesis
cards.line: Book of the Law of the Old Testament, 50 chapters.

cards.name: Habakkuk
cards.line: Habakkuk, a prophet, wrote the book bearing his name, which records his dialogue with God about justice and faith.

cards.name: Hadadezer
cards.line: Hadadezer, king of Zobah, was defeated by King David in battle, and his allies, the Arameans, became subject to Israel.

cards.name: Haggai
cards.line: Haggai, a prophet during the post-exilic period, urged the people to rebuild the temple in Jerusalem.

cards.name: Hanun
cards.line: Hanun, the Ammonite king, mistreated David's envoys, leading to a war between the Ammonites and Israel.

cards.name: Hazael
cards.line: Hazael, king of Aram, was anointed by Elijah and fought against Israel and Judah.

cards.name: Hebrews
cards.line: Letter of the New Testament, 13 chapters.

cards.name: Herod the Great
cards.line: Herod the Great was the Roman-appointed king of Judea who ruled during the time of Jesus' birth.

cards.name: Hophra
cards.line: Hophra, also known as Pharaoh Apries, was the king of Egypt during the time of the prophet Jeremiah and the Babylonian invasion of Judah.

cards.name: Huldah
cards.line: Huldah was a prophetess who was consulted by King Josiah's officials regarding the authenticity of the Book of the Law discovered during temple repairs.

cards.name: Ish-bosheth
cards.line: Ish-bosheth (also called Eshbaal), Saul's son, was made king over Israel by Abner but was ultimately assassinated, leading to David's rule over all Israel.

cards.name: Ithamar
cards.line: Ithamar was the fourth and youngest son of Aaron, who served as a priest alongside his brothers Nadab, Abihu, and Eleazar.

cards.name: James brother of Jesus
cards.line: James, the brother of Jesus, was a leader in the Jerusalem church and is traditionally named as the author of the epistle of James.

cards.name: James
cards.line: Letter of the New Testament, 5 chapters.

cards.name: Jephthah
cards.line: Jephthah was a judge of Israel who delivered the Israelites from the Ammonites but made a tragic vow that resulted in the sacrifice of his daughter.

cards.name: John
cards.line: Gospel of the New Testament, 21 chapters.

cards.name: Joanna
cards.line: Joanna, the wife of Chuza, was one of the women who followed and supported Jesus during His earthly ministry.

cards.name: Jonah
cards.line: Prophet book of the Old Testament, 4 chapters.

cards.name: Joshua
cards.line: History book of the Old Testament, 24 chapters.

cards.name: Joseph of Arimathea
cards.line: Joseph of Arimathea was a wealthy disciple who buried Jesus in his own new tomb.

cards.name: Joshua
cards.line: Joshua, the son of Nun, was Moses' assistant and successor who led the Israelites into the Promised Land.

cards.name: Jude
cards.line: Letter of the New Testament, 1 chapters.

cards.name: Judas Barsabas
cards.line: Judas, also known as Barsabbas, was a prophet and respected leader in the Jerusalem church who accompanied Paul and Barnabas to Antioch.

cards.name: Jude brother of Jesus
cards.line: Jude, a brother of Jesus, was the author of the Epistle of Jude and is mentioned in the lists of Jesus' siblings.

cards.name: Luke
cards.line: Gospel of the New Testament, 24 chapters.

cards.name: Luke
cards.line: Luke, a physician and companion of Paul, was the author of the Gospel of Luke and the Book of Acts.

cards.name: Lysanias
cards.line: Lysanias, the tetrarch of Abilene, ruled during the time of John the Baptist's ministry (Luk.3.1).

cards.name: Malachi
cards.line: Malachi, a prophet, received the word of the Lord to Israel.

cards.name: Manaen
cards.line: Manaen, a prophet and teacher, was part of the church at Antioch.

cards.name: Mark
cards.line: Mark (also called John), a relative of Barnabas and Paul's companion, is traditionally named as the author of the Gospel of Mark.

cards.name: Martha
cards.line: Martha, the sister of Mary and Lazarus, hosted Jesus in her home.

cards.name: Mary of Bethany
cards.line: Mary, the sister of Martha and Lazarus, sat at Jesus' feet and anointed Him with perfume.

cards.name: Mary Magdalene
cards.line: Mary Magdalene, a follower of Jesus, was the first to witness His resurrection.

cards.name: Matthew
cards.line: Matthew, also known as Levi, was a tax collector who became one of Jesus' twelve apostles and authored the Gospel of Matthew.

cards.name: Matthias
cards.line: Matthias was chosen by lot to replace Judas Iscariot as one of the twelve apostles.

cards.name: Melchizedek
cards.line: Melchizedek, king of Salem and priest of God Most High, who blessed Abraham.

cards.name: Menahem
cards.line: Menahem, king of Israel, known for his cruelty and for paying tribute to Assyria.

cards.name: Merodach-baladan
cards.line: Merodach-baladan, king of Babylon, sent letters and a gift to Hezekiah, king of Judah.

cards.name: Micah
cards.line: Prophet book of the Old Testament, 7 chapters.

cards.name: Mark
cards.line: Gospel of the New Testament, 16 chapters.

cards.name: Naomi
cards.line: Naomi, also known as Mara, was an Israelite woman who, after losing her husband and sons, returned from Moab to Bethlehem with her daughter-in-law Ruth.

cards.name: Nathanael
cards.line: Nathanael, also known as Bartholomew, was one of Jesus' twelve disciples, who was initially skeptical but later confessed Jesus as the Son of God.

cards.name: Nebuchadnezzar
cards.line: Nebuchadnezzar II was the powerful Emperor of Babylon who destroyed Jerusalem and exiled the Jews.

cards.name: Neco
cards.line: Pharaoh Neco II, the ruler of Egypt, opposed King Josiah of Judah, installed Jehoiakim as a vassal king, and was later defeated by Nebuchadnezzar of Babylon.

cards.name: Nehemiah
cards.line: History book of the Old Testament, 13 chapters.

cards.name: Obadiah
cards.line: Prophet book of the Old Testament, 1 chapters.

cards.name: Og
cards.line: Og was the Amorite king of Bashan who was defeated by the Israelites during their journey to the Promised Land.

cards.name: Paul
cards.line: Paul, also known as Saul, the apostle to the Gentiles and author of many New Testament epistles.

cards.name: Pekahiah
cards.line: Pekahiah, son of Menahem, king of Israel who reigned for 2 years before being assassinated.

cards.name: Philip the evangelist
cards.line: Philip, one of the seven deacons chosen by the early church in Jerusalem, who preached the gospel in Samaria and baptized an Ethiopian eunuch.

cards.name: Philemon
cards.line: Letter of the New Testament, 1 chapters.

cards.name: Proverbs
cards.line: Poetry and wisdom book of the Old Testament, 31 chapters.

cards.name: Queen of Sheba
cards.line: The Queen of Sheba visited King Solomon, tested him with questions, and praised his wisdom and prosperity.

cards.name: Quirinius
cards.line: Quirinius was the governor of Syria when a census was taken, as mentioned in Luke's Gospel.

cards.name: Rahab
cards.line: Rahab, a Canaanite woman from Jericho, hid the Israelite spies and was spared during the city's destruction.

cards.name: Rebekah
cards.line: Rebekah was the wife of Isaac and the mother of Jacob and Esau.

cards.name: Rezin
cards.line: Rezin was the king of Aram (Syria) who allied with Pekah, king of Israel, against Ahaz, king of Judah.

cards.name: Samuel
cards.line: Samuel was a prophet and the last judge of Israel before the establishment of the monarchy, who anointed both Saul and David as kings.

cards.name: Sargon
cards.line: Sargon, king of Assyria, sent his commander (the Tartan) to fight against the Philistine city of Ashdod, which he took.

cards.name: Sennacherib
cards.line: Sennacherib, king of Assyria, invaded Judah in the reign of King Hezekiah and besieged Jerusalem.

cards.name: Sergius Paulus
cards.line: Sergius Paulus, the proconsul of Cyprus, was an intelligent man who sought to hear the word of God and believed after witnessing Paul's confrontation with Elymas the sorcerer.

cards.name: Shalmaneser
cards.line: Shalmaneser, king of Assyria, besieged Samaria and conquered the northern kingdom of Israel, exiling its inhabitants and ending the kingdom's existence.

cards.name: Silas
cards.line: Silas (or Silvanus) was a prominent member of the Jerusalem church who accompanied Paul on his second missionary journey and co-wrote some of his epistles.

cards.name: Simeon called Niger
cards.line: Simeon, also called Niger, was a prophet and teacher in the church at Antioch who was involved in sending Paul and Barnabas on their first missionary journey.

cards.name: Stephen
cards.line: Stephen, one of the seven deacons chosen by the early church, was full of faith and the Holy Spirit, performed miracles, and became the first Christian martyr after his powerful testimony before the Sanhedrin.

cards.name: Thomas
cards.line: Thomas, also called Didymus, was one of Jesus' twelve disciples, known for doubting Jesus' resurrection until he saw him in person.

cards.name: Timothy
cards.line: Timothy was a young disciple and co-worker of Paul, who accompanied him on his missionary journeys and later served as a pastor.

cards.name: Tirhakah
cards.line: Tirhakah, the king of Cush (Ethiopia), opposed Sennacherib's invasion of Judah during the reign of King Hezekiah.

cards.name: Titus
cards.line: Letter of the New Testament, 3 chapters.

cards.name: Uzziah
cards.line: Uzziah (Azariah) was king of Judah, known for his long and prosperous reign.

cards.name: Zebedee
cards.line: Zebedee was the father of James and John, two of Jesus' twelve apostles, and was a fisherman by trade.

cards.name: Zedekiah
cards.line: Zedekiah, originally named Mattaniah, was the last king of Judah before the Babylonian exile.

cards.name: Zimri
cards.line: Zimri, a commander of half of Israel's chariots, became king after assassinating Elah, but his reign lasted only seven days.
